title: Kere’ach (the Bald One)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bekhorot 58a Ben Azzai said: “All the sages of Israel seem to me like a garlic peel, except this bald one” (that is, Rabbi Akiva, according to Rashi; see also Tosafot there).[^1]

notes.text: Rashi identifies the bald one as Rabbi Akiva. Tosafot challenges Rashi’s associated genealogy and chronology, reports Rabbenu Nissim’s interpretation involving Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya, and reports Rabbenu Tam’s interpretation as a personal name. Hyman’s Akiva identification remains explicitly attributed to Rashi, not a unanimous commentary conclusion.
